title: tannerhill 交叉转运空白仪器 01
instruction:
您是 Yolanda Andersen，Emberline 学区的接待员，为 Pembroke Foundry 的客户自有铸件的夜班越库作业提供支持。彭布罗克正在开始三月份的建设，其中入站拖车直接前往出站负载：没有任何东西被存放或架起来，并且机构工作人员需要一个明确的拖车转向窗的首次使用工作说明。使用提供的文件`pembroke_crossdock_source.pdf`作为操作事实的唯一来源。请在工作目录的顶层创建`crossdock_receipt_inspection.xlsx`。它将被打印并保存在码头剪贴板上，然后在出境卡车等待时在电话旁边手工填写，因此使工作表实用、整洁，并且可打印在两页A4纵向页面上，一页用于说明，一页用于空白收货和检验记录。为下一个领取它的人提供简短的交接说明和紧凑的图例，以便未经培训的机构职员无需询问主管即可理解状态颜色和代码。该说明必须涵盖收货、计数、包装和可追溯性检查、可见损坏决策、计数不足或托盘故障分支以及必须记录的内容，但提出事实和记录要求而不是建议。
保持所有操作事实与提供的来源一致，并且不要发明客户、零件、数量、拖车、人员、日期或处置。表单本身必须为空：没有工作示例、占位符值或预先输入的记录。对 `count_status`、`package_status`、`trace_status`、`damage_status`、`inspection_status` 和 `disposition_code` 使用下拉菜单而不是自由格式的措辞；允许值分别为`MATCH, SHORT, OVER, NOT_CHECKED`； `ACCEPTABLE, DAMAGED, NOT_CHECKED`； `LEGIBLE, ILLEGIBLE, NOT_CHECKED`； `NONE, VISIBLE, NOT_CHECKED`； `PASS, FAIL, NOT_CHECKED`；和`RELEASE, HOLD, ESCALATE, NOT_SET`。添加第二个名为 `System_Export` 的工作表，并按此顺序精确地包含此标题行，以便另一个系统解析：`record_type, receipt_date, load_id, line_id, item_id, expected_qty, received_qty, count_status, package_status, trace_status, damage_status, inspection_status, disposition_code, exception_note, reviewer_id, reviewed_at`。将其记录行保留为空，将完成的文件写入工作目录而不是子文件夹中，并且不要添加徽标或装饰图像。

---

上面提到的文件在`references/`中：
- `references/pembroke_crossdock_source.pdf` — 唯一提供的操作源，描述工作指令必须忠实反映的跨站台收货、检查、异常处理、记录字段和时间上下文。

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：

- `crossdock_receipt_inspection.xlsx` — 空白、可打印的两页越库收货和检验工作说明和手工完成记录，以及固定的机器可读出口工作表。 （工作簿必须包含简明的说明/指导表、空白收货和检验表格以及名为System_Export的工作表。；打印输出必须恰好是两页A4纵向页：一页说明页后跟一页表格页；将每一页调整为一页宽和一页高。；不要预先填写任何操作记录，例如日期、身份、数量或答案；表格输入单元格和导出记录行必须为空。；使用数据验证下拉列表与所有六个编码字段的请求中规定的值完全一致。；System_Export 必须具有指定顺序的完全指定的 16 标头和空白记录行。；包括拾取指南、图例、忠实来源的分支，并且没有徽标或装饰图像。）
除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

materials.description: 沿用南杨原题包实际文件与已有公开预览。
materials.note: PDF 文字提取；可打开原文件查看排版。
materials.text:
Pembroke Foundry cross-dock receipt memo

Emberline School District is the administrative client context for the March build. Customer-owned castings
move during the night-shift trailer turn window directly from the inbound trailer to the outbound load.
Material is not put away or racked.

For each receipt line, compare the quantity against the receiving paperwork and record both the expected
quantity and the received quantity. Check packaging condition, label and traceability legibility, and visible
damage.

A shortage, visible damage, illegible traceability, or failed inspection is recorded in the exception note.
Such a finding is held or escalated according to the supplied handoff contact while the outbound truck is
present. The record identifies the receipt date, load, line, item, reviewer, and review time.

gold.description: 沿用南杨原题包实际文件与已有公开预览。
gold.note: 值与公式提取，不还原原始排版；每表最多120行、30列。

sheets.name: Instructions
rows: March build | customer-owned castings | night-shift trailer turn window
Move material directly from the inbound trailer to the outbound load. Material is not put away or racked.
Use the receiving paperwork. For every line, compare quantity and write the expected quantity, received quantity, and count status on the Receipt Record.
Check packaging condition. Record package status for each line.
Check that the label and traceability information are legible. Record trace status separately from package status.
Inspect for visible damage. Record damage status and inspection status for each line.
When the count is SHORT or inspection is FAIL, write the finding in the Exception Note. Record HOLD or ESCALATE as directed by the supplied handoff contact while the outbound truck is present.
Write an Exception Note for a shortage, visible damage, illegible traceability, or failed inspection. Use the line-level Exception Note area on the Receipt Record.
For the next person: pick up this completed record, review every coded line and Exception Note, then use the supplied handoff contact for any HOLD or ESCALATE entry.
CODE LEGEND - choose only the listed codes in the shaded coded cells
STATUS COLOURS: green = acceptable/release; amber = not checked or hold; red = short, damage, illegible, fail, or escalate.

sheets.name: Receipt_Record
rows: Write in white fields. Choose codes in blue fields. Add a line-level Exception Note for each abnormal finding.
Exception Note - use for shortages, visible damage, illegible traceability, or failed inspection
Exception Note - use for shortages, visible damage, illegible traceability, or failed inspection

criteria.description: 提交的文件是可读的 XLSX 工作簿。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿包并使用办公室库解析器成功打开。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用 openpyxl 打开并确认没有修复警告或不可读的工作表 XML。

original.criterion: The submitted file is a readable XLSX workbook.
original.evidence: Workbook package and successful open with an office-library parser.
original.grader_hint: Open with openpyxl and confirm no repair warning or unreadable worksheet XML.

criteria.description: 存在名为 System_Export 的工作表。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿工作表名称。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查工作簿.工作表。

original.criterion: A worksheet named System_Export exists.
original.grader_hint: Inspect workbook.worksheets.

criteria.description: System_Export 行 1 按照请求的顺序准确包含 16 请求的标头。
criteria.evidence: System_Export 标题单元格。
criteria.grader_hint: 读取连续的非空第一行单元格并比较确切的字符串和顺序。

original.criterion: System_Export row 1 contains exactly the 16 requested headers, in the requested order.
original.grader_hint: Read the contiguous non-empty first-row cells and compare exact strings and order.

criteria.description: System_Export 有一个机器可读的表格区域，没有合并的标题单元格，没有装饰列，也没有非标题记录值。
criteria.evidence: 工作表尺寸、合并和单元格值。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查行1仅具有16标题，并且声明的记录区域中标题下方的所有单元格均为空。

original.criterion: System_Export has a machine-readable tabular region with no merged header cells, no decorative columns, and no non-header record values.
original.evidence: Worksheet dimensions, merges, and cell values.
original.grader_hint: Check row 1 only has the 16 headers and all cells below the header in the declared record region are empty.

criteria.description: 六个编码表单字段每个都有一个数据验证列表，其允许的值与请求中的相应列表完全匹配。
criteria.evidence: DataValidation 对象及其 sqref/formula1 值。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅规范化 Excel 列表引用；将每个列表作为有序集与六个指定列表进行比较，并确保每个列表适用于预期的字段单元格。

original.criterion: The six coded form fields each have a data-validation list whose permitted values exactly match the corresponding list in the request.
original.evidence: DataValidation objects and their sqref/formula1 values.
original.grader_hint: Normalize only Excel list quoting; compare each list as an ordered set to the six specified lists and ensure each applies to the intended field cells.

criteria.description: 该表格包括不同的收货日期字段、装载/拖车标识符字段、审阅者字段和审阅时间字段。
criteria.evidence: 表单上的可见标签和相邻输入单元格。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查渲染的表单和工作表标签；接受拖车/负载标识符的合理等效措辞。

original.criterion: The form includes a distinct receipt date field, load/trailer identifier field, reviewer field, and review-time field.
original.evidence: Visible labels and adjacent entry cells on the form sheet.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the rendered form and worksheet labels; accept reasonable equivalent wording for trailer/load identifier.

criteria.description: 该表单提供了项目或零件标识以及预期和接收数量的行级字段。
criteria.evidence: 形成表格标题。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认行标识、项目/零件标识、预期数量和接收数量的单独可写列/区域。

original.criterion: The form provides line-level fields for item or part identity and expected and received quantities.
original.grader_hint: Confirm separate writable columns/areas for line identity, item/part identity, expected quantity, and received quantity.

criteria.description: 该表单提供了包装、可追溯性、可见损坏、检验结果、处置代码、异常注释、审核者身份和审核时间的行级字段。
criteria.evidence: 形成表格标题和条目单元格。
criteria.grader_hint: 将每个概念与单独的可用字段相匹配；不要奖励单个通用注释字段来代替所需的编码字段。

original.criterion: The form provides line-level fields for packaging, traceability, visible damage, inspection result, disposition code, exception note, reviewer identity, and review time.
original.evidence: Form table headers and entry cells.
original.grader_hint: Match each concept to a separate usable field; do not award for a single generic comments field substituting for the required coded fields.

criteria.description: 说明表包含供下一个使用该工件的人使用的简明拾取或移交说明。
criteria.evidence: 说明书文本。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找明确的下一人/交接提示，告诉下游用户如何处理已完成的记录。

original.criterion: The instruction sheet contains a concise pickup or handoff note for the next person using the artifact.
original.grader_hint: Look for an explicit next-person/handoff cue that tells the downstream user what to do with the completed record.

criteria.description: 该工作簿包含一个图例，解释编码状态以及表单上使用的任何颜色含义。
criteria.evidence: 图例文本和格式。
criteria.grader_hint: 图例必须将显示的状态颜色或符号映射为可理解的含义并识别编码选项。

original.criterion: The workbook contains a legend explaining the coded statuses and any colour meaning used on the form.
original.grader_hint: The legend must map the displayed status colours or symbols to understandable meanings and identify the coded choices.

criteria.description: 该工作簿的可打印输出正好是两页，A4 纵向，每个预期页面适合一页宽和一页高。
criteria.evidence: 打印设置和渲染的 PDF 页面几何形状/计数。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用无头办公工具或同等工具进行渲染；检查页数、纸张尺寸、方向和适合设置。从打印区域中排除非打印导出表。

original.criterion: The workbook's printable output is exactly two pages, A4 portrait, with each intended page fit to one page wide and one page tall.
original.evidence: Print settings and rendered PDF page geometry/count.
original.grader_hint: Render with a headless office tool or equivalent; inspect page count, paper size, orientation, and fit settings. Exclude the non-printing export sheet from the print area.

criteria.description: 第一打印页是说明/指导页，第二打印页是空白收据和检查表。
criteria.evidence: 渲染的页面顺序和可见标题。
criteria.grader_hint: 通过标题和内容（而不是仅通过工作表选项卡顺序）呈现和识别每个页面。

original.criterion: The first printed page is the instruction/guidance page and the second printed page is the blank receipt-and-inspection form.
original.evidence: Rendered page order and visible titles.
original.grader_hint: Render and identify each page by its title and content, not by worksheet tab order alone.

criteria.description: 说明和表格的打印区域不包括System_Export，并且不会产生额外的打印页面。
criteria.evidence: print_area 和页面设置属性。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查定义的打印区域并渲染工作簿。

original.criterion: The instruction and form sheets have print areas that exclude System_Export and do not produce an additional printed page.
original.grader_hint: Inspect defined print areas and render the workbook.

criteria.description: 空白表单使用条件格式或与编码字段相关的等效可见状态提示，并且图例与这些提示一致。
criteria.evidence: ConditionalFormatting 规则和呈现的外观。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受六个编码字段或其结果/处置单元格的规则；验证图例描述的语义颜色是否相同。

original.criterion: The blank form uses conditional formatting or equivalent visible status cues tied to the coded fields, and the legend agrees with those cues.
original.grader_hint: Accept rules for the six coded fields or their result/disposition cells; verify that the legend describes the same semantic colours.

criteria.description: 工作簿中未嵌入装饰性徽标或图像对象。
criteria.evidence: 工作表绘图/图像关系。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查工作簿介质和绘图部分；普通边框和填充不算作图像。

original.criterion: No decorative logo or image object is embedded in the workbook.
original.grader_hint: Inspect workbook media and drawing parts; ordinary borders and fills do not count as images.

criteria.description: 收据表单上的所有操作输入单元格均为空白：未预先输入任何文本、数字、日期、公式或示例值。
criteria.evidence: 表单输入区域中的单元格值。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用标签和验证范围来识别入口单元格；忽略标签、标题、图例标签和固定说明。

original.criterion: All operational entry cells on the receipt form are blank: no text, number, date, formula, or example value is pre-entered.
original.evidence: Cell values in the form's entry region.
original.grader_hint: Use labels and validation ranges to identify entry cells; ignore labels, headings, legend labels, and fixed instructions.

criteria.description: System_Export标题下的所有记录行都是空白的，包括编码和注释字段。
criteria.evidence: System_Export 单元格值。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查表/数据区域中的每一行，而不仅仅是第一个空白行。

original.criterion: All record rows beneath the System_Export headers are blank, including coded and note fields.
original.grader_hint: Check every row in the table/data region, not merely the first blank row.

criteria.description: 工作簿的空白表单输入单元格或 System_Export 记录行中不包含任何公式。
criteria.evidence: 单元格数据类型/公式文本。
criteria.grader_hint: 在所有输入和导出记录单元格中搜索公式；其他地方允许使用固定的说明文本。

original.criterion: The workbook contains no formulas in blank form entry cells or System_Export record rows.
original.grader_hint: Search all entry and export-record cells for formulas; fixed instructional text is allowed elsewhere.

criteria.description: 该指令规定，物料从入库直接越库到出库，并且不存放或上架。
criteria.evidence: 说明书散文。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要直接的入库到出库处理和明确的无上架/无货架限制。

original.criterion: The instruction states that material is cross-docked directly from inbound to outbound and is not put away or racked.
original.grader_hint: Require both direct inbound-to-outbound handling and an explicit no-put-away/no-racking limitation.

criteria.description: 该指令标识了 March 构建环境和客户拥有的铸件，而无需发明不同的操作环境。
criteria.evidence: 说明书散文。
criteria.grader_hint: 搜索渲染文本以了解 March/build 和客户拥有的铸造概念。

original.criterion: The instruction identifies the March build context and customer-owned castings without inventing a different operating context.
original.grader_hint: Search rendered text for March/build and customer-owned casting concepts.

criteria.description: 该指令告诉用户根据提供的接收信息验证数量并记录预期和接收的数量。
criteria.evidence: 指导散文和表格标签。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找比较和记录，而不仅仅是数量栏。

original.criterion: The instruction tells the user to verify quantity against the supplied receiving information and record expected and received quantities.
original.grader_hint: Look for both comparison and recording, not merely a quantity column.

criteria.description: 该说明涵盖包装状况和标签/可追溯性的易读性作为单独检查。
criteria.evidence: 指令散文和编码字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要单独的包装和可追溯性概念。

original.criterion: The instruction covers packaging condition and label/traceability legibility as separate checks.
original.grader_hint: Require separate packaging and traceability concepts.

criteria.description: 该说明涵盖可见损坏检查。
criteria.evidence: 指导散文。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果没有明显损坏的措辞，一般的质量检查是不够的。

original.criterion: The instruction covers visible damage inspection.
original.grader_hint: A generic quality check is insufficient without visible-damage wording.

criteria.description: 该指令定义了当出站卡车存在时计数不足或托盘发生故障时应采取的措施，而不建议采取不受支持的业务操作。
criteria.evidence: 指令中的分支文本。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要明确的短/失败分支、基于所提供源的记录/升级方向，并且没有发明的处置规则。

original.criterion: The instruction defines what to do when a count is short or a pallet fails while the outbound truck is present, without recommending an unsupported business action.
original.grader_hint: Require an explicit short/fail branch, recording/escalation direction grounded in the supplied source, and no invented disposition rule.

criteria.description: 该指令说明了哪些例外情况必须收到书面注释，并标识该注释的记录位置。
criteria.evidence: 指导散文和exception_note领域。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受将异常发现链接到异常注释字段的简洁措辞。

original.criterion: The instruction says what exceptions must receive a written note and identifies the record location for that note.
original.grader_hint: Accept concise wording that links abnormal findings to the exception note field.

criteria.description: 该指令的编码词汇与六个验证列表以及相应的System_Export列完全一致。
criteria.evidence: 指令、验证对象和导出标头映射。
criteria.grader_hint: 比较所有三个地点的每个代码系列；没有无法解释的同义词或不匹配的映射。

original.criterion: The instruction's coded vocabulary agrees exactly with the six validation lists and with the corresponding System_Export columns.
original.evidence: Instruction, validation objects, and export header mapping.
original.grader_hint: Compare each code family across all three locations; no unexplained synonyms or mismatched mappings.

criteria.description: 每个System_Export字段在表单或指令中都有一个明确的对应项，没有无法从空白工具填充的导出标头。
criteria.evidence: 表单字段和导出标题之间的交叉。
criteria.grader_hint: 将所有16标头映射到可见的表单字段或明确规定的固定记录元数据；拒绝孤立列。

original.criterion: Each System_Export field has an unambiguous counterpart in the form or instruction, with no export header that cannot be populated from the blank instrument.
original.evidence: Crosswalk between form fields and export headers.
original.grader_hint: Map all 16 headers to visible form fields or clearly stated fixed record metadata; reject orphan columns.

criteria.description: 该工作簿对 receipt_date、expected_qty、received_qty 和 reviewed_at 使用适当的数字/日期/时间格式，无需预先填充值。
criteria.evidence: number_format 属性和空白单元格。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受标准日期、整数数量和日期时间格式；不需要特定的格式代码。

original.criterion: The workbook uses appropriate number/date/time formats for receipt_date, expected_qty, received_qty, and reviewed_at without pre-populating values.
original.grader_hint: Accept standard date, integer quantity, and date-time formats; do not require a particular format code.

criteria.description: 编码的条目单元格受到保护，不受任意键入的值的影响，同时通过其下拉列表保持可用，或者工作簿以其他方式明确限制对所提供列表的条目。
criteria.evidence: 工作表保护和验证错误设置。
criteria.grader_hint: 当验证配置为阻止无效条目时奖励；如果停止式验证有效，则保护是可选的。

original.criterion: The coded entry cells are protected from arbitrary typed values while remaining usable through their dropdowns, or the workbook otherwise clearly constrains entry to the supplied lists.
original.evidence: Sheet protection and validation error settings.
original.grader_hint: Award when validation is configured to stop invalid entries; protection is optional if Stop-style validation is effective.

criteria.description: 打印的表格具有足够的清晰界限的书写空间，可用于所需的行级字段和例外注释，而无需剪裁或重叠。
criteria.evidence: 渲染的第二页。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据打印比例进行判断：标题和输入区域必须清晰，边框不得重叠，注释区域必须可以手写。

original.criterion: The printed form has enough clearly bounded writing space for the required line-level fields and an exception note without clipping or overlap.
original.grader_hint: Judge at print scale: headers and entry areas must be legible, borders must not overlap, and the note area must be writable by hand.

criteria.description: 第一次上夜班的机构职员可以按照指示完成记录，无需培训或猜测每个代码的含义。
criteria.evidence: 渲染的说明页面、图例和表单一起考虑。
criteria.grader_hint: 专业审查：检查序列清晰度、分支可见性、简单语言以及拖车转弯期间的即时可用性。

original.criterion: A first-time night-shift agency clerk could follow the instruction and complete the record without training or guessing what each code means.
original.evidence: Rendered instruction page, legend, and form considered together.

source_file.content: Create one concise synthetic source memo for the Pembroke Foundry operation. State that Emberline School District is the administrative client context, customer-owned castings for the March build move directly from inbound trailer to outbound load during a trailer turn window, with no put-away or racking. Define the source-backed checks as count against receiving paperwork, packaging condition, label/traceability legibility, and visible damage. State that shortages, visible damage, illegible traceability, or failed inspection are recorded in an exception note and held/escalated according to the supplied handoff contact; do not introduce a customer, part, quantity, date, or named individual beyond the permitted entities. Include enough wording for a solver to extract facts but no template or procedure layout.

original_instruction:
You are Yolanda Andersen, the receiving clerk at Emberline School District, supporting Pembroke Foundry's night-shift cross-dock operation for customer-owned castings. Pembroke is starting a March build in which inbound trailers go straight to outbound loads: nothing is put away or racked, and the agency crew needs a clear first-use work instruction for the trailer turn window. Use the supplied file `pembroke_crossdock_source.pdf` as the only source of operational facts. Please create `crossdock_receipt_inspection.xlsx` in the top level of the working directory. It will be printed and kept on a dock clipboard, then completed by hand beside a phone while the outbound truck is waiting, so make the working form practical, uncluttered, and printable on exactly two A4 portrait pages, one page for the instruction and one page for the blank receipt-and-inspection record. Include a short handoff note for the next person who picks it up and a compact legend so an untrained agency clerk can understand the status colours and codes without asking a supervisor. The instruction must cover the receipt, count, packaging and traceability checks, the visible-damage decision, the short-count or failed-pallet branch, and what must be written down, but present facts and recording requirements rather than recommendations. Keep all operational facts consistent with the supplied source and do not invent a customer, part, quantity, trailer, person, date, or disposition. The form itself must ship empty: no worked examples, placeholder values, or pre-entered records. Use dropdowns rather than free-form wording for `count_status`, `package_status`, `trace_status`, `damage_status`, `inspection_status`, and `disposition_code`; the permitted values are respectively `MATCH, SHORT, OVER, NOT_CHECKED`; `ACCEPTABLE, DAMAGED, NOT_CHECKED`; `LEGIBLE, ILLEGIBLE, NOT_CHECKED`; `NONE, VISIBLE, NOT_CHECKED`; `PASS, FAIL, NOT_CHECKED`; and `RELEASE, HOLD, ESCALATE, NOT_SET`. Add a second worksheet named `System_Export` with exactly this header row, in this order, for another system to parse: `record_type, receipt_date, load_id, line_id, item_id, expected_qty, received_qty, count_status, package_status, trace_status, damage_status, inspection_status, disposition_code, exception_note, reviewer_id, reviewed_at`. Leave its record rows empty, write the completed files into the working directory rather than a subfolder, and do not add a logo or decorative image.

---

The files referred to above are in `references/`:

- `references/pembroke_crossdock_source.pdf` — The sole supplied operational source describing the cross-dock receipt, inspection, exception handling, recording fields, and timing context that the work instruction must faithfully reflect.

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `crossdock_receipt_inspection.xlsx` — A blank, printable two-page cross-dock receipt-and-inspection work instruction and hand-completion record, with a fixed machine-readable export worksheet. (The workbook must contain a concise instruction/guidance sheet, a blank receipt-and-inspection form, and a worksheet named System_Export.; Print output must be exactly two A4 portrait pages: one instruction page followed by one form page; fit each page to one page wide and one page tall.; Do not prefill any operational record, example, date, identity, quantity, or answer; form entry cells and export record rows must be empty.; Use data-validation dropdowns with exactly the permitted values stated in the request for all six coded fields.; System_Export must have exactly the specified 16 headers in the specified order and blank record rows.; Include pickup guidance, a legend, source-faithful branches, and no logo or decorative image.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
